review: One reviewer scores anonymized source, candidate tests and design notes before unmasking identities and functional results. Subjective scores are not objective capability facts. Retain reasons and source hashes.

scale.2: Mixed quality with substantial maintainability concerns
scale.3: Good, reviewable work with limited weaknesses
scale.4: Excellent clarity and judgment within the task constraints

dimensions.structure_readability: Cohesive functions, meaningful names, simple control flow and legible data transformations.
dimensions.invariant_maintainability: Concurrency, state transitions and authority boundaries are explicit and easy to audit; no hidden in-memory source of truth.
dimensions.error_recovery_design: Clear error boundaries, deliberate retry and fencing behavior, useful errors, no swallowed persistence failures or tangled recovery paths.
dimensions.test_quality: Candidate-written tests target meaningful races, boundary conditions, restart and failure behavior, with deterministic synchronization and useful assertions.
dimensions.engineering_judgment: Scope discipline, minimal unnecessary machinery, and an honest explanation of delivery, cancellation and crash guarantees.

functional: 19 independent public/hidden checks, scope, actual code and accepted completion are reported separately. A style score cannot excuse functional failure.
